station_design.independence_claim: Only simulated physical stations; not 82 independent natural regions

model.fit_procedure: exact pre-existing fit_conditional_branch_model on six collapsed sufficient statistics (full-day equal offset)
model.test_score: pre-existing per-station average of six-bin conditional logscore differences, divided by fixed 41*6 original cells
model.selection_rule: choose shape only if test-site-equal mean heldout gain >0

two_projections: Sample each world ONCE in solar phase; convert exactly same timestamped events to six 4-hour civil clock bins and six solar-phase bins. Do not resample independent observations for different projections.
solar_phase_density: 1 + amplitude*exp(kappa*(cos(2*pi*(phase-peak)/24)-1)); same phase density for both branches
provenance_of_profiles: Predeclared subset of five profiles already publicly examined in PR234. Choosing smooth_evening after its larger oracle gain is disclosed; this is a post-PR234 prospective synthetic stress test, not independent blind discovery.

event_sampling.algorithm: Poisson(total_mean), iid station(82), pair(41), photoperiod_branch(2), phase from pretabulated smooth inverse-CDF; same event used for both time projections
event_sampling.total_events_exposure_units: Expected summed across all 82 synthetic stations, 41 matched pairs and both paired dates combined

metrics.primary: P(clock score >0 AND solar score <=0), Monte Carlo across independent worlds

calibration_tests: phase to civil mapping eventwise invertible
same event counts used in both projections
total counts exactly conserved within every simulated station×pair×branch
collapsed six-bin sufficient statistics produce same fit and heldout scores as original raw-cell implementation
no analytic expected-score oracle substituted for fitted prediction
all 41 original pair dates used even for stations with no detections
run exactly predeclared 3*3*200 worlds without post-outcome tuning
